case_title: Hajabhai Rajashibhai Odedara v. State of Gujarat
aggravating_circumstances: Attempted murder of the victim's brother, conspiracy to kill family members
mitigating_circumstances: Benefit of doubt given to the eye-witness due to his age and injuries, accused failed to explain incriminating circumstances
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 302, 307, and 328 of the IPC
neutral_facts: The accused and co-accused, who were in love, conspired to kill the family members of the co-accused. They strangled the mother and uncle of the co-accused, and attempted to kill the brother of the co-accused, who survived and became the sole eye-witness. A pesticide bottle was recovered from the scene, which was later established to have been purchased by the accused. The prosecution relied heavily on the testimony of the eye-witness, who provided conflicting statements over time. The accused was tried by the trial court and convicted under Sections 302, 307, and 328 of the IPC. The High Court affirmed the conviction.
